command: set -euo pipefail; APK=app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb install "$APK"; adb shell pm path io.blueeye | grep -q '^package:'; adb shell dumpsys package io.blueeye | grep -E 'versionCode=|versionName=' | head -n 2; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/tmp/tracker-monkey.txt 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/tracker-monkey.txt; exit 30; }; sleep 2; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; echo APP_PID=$PID; echo ACCEPTED_APK_INSTALL_PASS; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
